projects.name: Analytics Dashboard Platform
projects.description:
A unified analytics dashboard platform combining three data domains: (1) customer CSV file processing and data quality, (2) application log analysis and anomaly detection, and (3) interactive visualization components. The program is organized into five milestones: platform foundation, CSV data ingestion/processing, log analysis pipeline, visualization & dashboard components, and quality/deployment/launch.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-engineering, visualization, log-analysis

tasks.name: M1: Platform Foundation & Shared Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the shared technical foundation both data domains and the visualization layer depend on: architecture decisions, repository and CI/CD, authentication/authorization, configuration and metadata storage, and observability. This milestone must land early because CSV processing, log analysis, and dashboards all consume its outputs.

tasks.name: M2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Ingest, validate, normalize, and store customer CSV files so dashboard metrics are trustworthy and reproducible. Covers schema discovery, ingestion service, validation/cleansing rules, incremental sync and deduplication, storage modeling, and data quality monitoring.

tasks.name: M3: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Collect, parse, enrich, and analyze application logs to surface error rates, latency, and anomaly signals for the dashboard. Covers log source inventory, parsing pipeline, normalization/enrichment, anomaly detection, query layer, and retention policy.

tasks.name: M4: Visualization & Dashboard Components
tasks.details: Design and build the user-facing dashboard: metric catalog, reusable chart component library, CSV-driven dashboard views, log analytics views, cross-filtering, and export/sharing. Depends on the data contracts produced by M2 and M3.

tasks.name: M5: Quality, Deployment & Launch
tasks.details: Harden and ship the platform: automated test strategy, performance/load validation, security and compliance review, staging UAT, production rollout with monitoring, and user documentation/enablement.

tasks.name: Architecture decision records & tech stack selection
tasks.details: Evaluate and document stack choices for batch processing, log storage, query engine, API layer, and charting library. Produce ADRs covering: storage engine choice, processing framework, dashboard frontend framework, and hosting model. Output is a signed-off ADR set that unblocks all downstream build tasks.

tasks.name: Repository scaffolding & CI/CD pipeline
tasks.details: Set up monorepo/service layout, linting and formatting, unit-test harness, container builds, and automated CI pipeline (build, test, image publish). Include environment configuration templates and branch protection.

tasks.name: Authentication, authorization & tenant access model
tasks.details: SSO/OIDC login, session handling, role definitions (viewer/analyst/admin), and row/column-level access rules so customer CSV data is scoped per tenant. Includes API token issuance for scheduled exports. Broken into sub-tasks due to complexity.

tasks.name: Configuration & metadata store
tasks.details: Central registry for dataset definitions, CSV schema versions, metric definitions, and dashboard layouts. Provides versioned config with validation on write and a read API for the processing and dashboard services.

tasks.name: Observability baseline: logging, metrics & error tracking
tasks.details: Structured JSON logging standard, request tracing IDs propagated across ingestion and query services, service health metrics, and error tracking integration so dashboard data freshness issues are diagnosable.

tasks.name: CSV schema discovery & data profiling
tasks.details: Inventory the customer CSV exports: column names, types, null rates, cardinality, encoding, delimiter and quoting quirks, and known dirty-data patterns. Produce a written data contract per file family that downstream validation rules and dashboard metrics are built against.

tasks.name: CSV ingestion service with chunked upload
tasks.details: Upload endpoint and worker that accept large CSV files, stream-parse in chunks to bound memory, record ingestion runs, and quarantine malformed rows. Broken into sub-tasks due to complexity.

tasks.name: Validation & cleansing rules engine
tasks.details: Declarative rule set per data contract: type coercion, required fields, date formats, email/phone normalization, currency parsing, and reject-vs-repair policy. Rules are configurable without code changes and emit per-row validation results.

tasks.name: Incremental sync & deduplication
tasks.details: Detect re-uploaded and overlapping CSV files, compute stable customer record keys, and apply upsert semantics so repeat loads do not double-count revenue or customers in dashboard metrics.

tasks.name: Analytical storage model & partitioning
tasks.details: Design curated customer tables optimized for dashboard queries: conformed dimensions (customer, region, segment), fact tables for revenue/activity, partitioning and clustering keys, and materialized aggregates for common time grains.

tasks.name: Data quality monitoring & alerting
tasks.details: Automated post-load checks (row-count deltas, null-rate drift, rejected-row ratio, duplicate keys) with thresholds that raise alerts to the on-call channel and a freshness badge surfaced on the dashboard.

tasks.name: Log source inventory & format specification
tasks.details: Enumerate every application log emitter (services, containers, load balancers), document formats (JSON lines, syslog, plaintext), field semantics, timestamp precision/timezone, and sample records. Produces the parsing contract for the pipeline.

tasks.name: Log ingestion & parsing pipeline
tasks.details: Collector/forwarder configuration plus a parsing stage that handles multiple log formats, extracts severity, service, trace ID and message, and routes unparseable lines to a dead-letter store. Broken into sub-tasks due to complexity.

tasks.name: Log normalization & enrichment
tasks.details: Map raw fields to a canonical schema, parse durations into milliseconds, resolve service and environment names, derive error categories from messages, and join request IDs to customer IDs where available.

tasks.name: Log query & aggregation layer
tasks.details: Pre-aggregated rollups (error rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, request volume per service per minute) plus a query API with time-range, service, severity and search filters that the dashboard views call. Broken into sub-tasks due to complexity.

tasks.name: Anomaly detection rules & baselines
tasks.details: Statistical baselines per service/metric (seasonal hour-of-day and day-of-week), threshold and deviation alert rules, suppression windows to avoid alert storms, and a scored anomaly feed the dashboard can render.

tasks.name: Retention, archival & lifecycle policy
tasks.details: Define hot/warm/cold tiers and retention windows per log class, implement scheduled archival of raw logs to object storage, and document deletion guarantees for compliance.

tasks.name: Metric catalog & dashboard UX definition
tasks.details: Whiteboard the dashboard information architecture: page list, primary user questions per page, metric definitions with exact formulas and grain, and chart-type choices. Output is a reviewed spec plus wireframes that the component build tasks implement.

tasks.name: Reusable chart component library
tasks.details: Build the shared chart primitives (time series line/area, bar, stacked bar, heatmap, KPI stat tile, table with sparklines) with consistent theming, loading/empty/error states, and accessible color palettes. Broken into sub-tasks due to complexity.

tasks.name: Customer CSV analytics dashboard views
tasks.details: Assemble the customer-facing pages from the component library: revenue trends, customer growth and churn cohorts, segment breakdowns, and a data-freshness indicator sourced from the CSV pipeline's quality metrics.

tasks.name: Log analytics & anomaly dashboard views
tasks.details: Build the operational pages: error-rate and latency trends per service, top error messages, log search with severity filters, and an anomaly timeline that links alerts back to the underlying log window.

tasks.name: Global filters & cross-filtering
tasks.details: Shared filter bar (date range, segment, region, service, severity) with URL-synced state, cross-chart highlighting that filters sibling charts, and query-result caching so filter changes stay responsive.

tasks.name: Export, sharing & scheduled reports
tasks.details: PNG/CSV/PDF export of any widget, shareable read-only dashboard links with scoped permissions, and a scheduler that emails a weekly PDF digest using the API tokens from the auth workstream.

tasks.name: Automated test strategy & test suites
tasks.details: Layered plan: unit tests for parsers and rules, contract tests for the data schemas, integration tests for each pipeline stage, and end-to-end smoke tests through the dashboard. Includes fixture datasets and coverage thresholds enforced in CI. Broken into sub-tasks due to complexity.

tasks.name: Performance & load testing
tasks.details: Benchmark CSV ingestion at target volume (largest expected file plus 3x safety margin), log ingestion throughput, and dashboard query latency at p95 under concurrent users. Record baselines and fix any stage exceeding budget.

tasks.name: Security & compliance review
tasks.details: Threat model the upload and query paths, verify tenant isolation and least-privilege roles, confirm PII handling in customer CSVs and logs, run dependency and container scanning, and close findings before launch.

tasks.name: Staging deployment & user acceptance testing
tasks.details: Deploy the full stack to staging with representative (anonymized) CSV and log data, run scripted UAT scenarios with the business owners, and triage feedback into a prioritized defect list.

tasks.name: Production rollout & monitoring
tasks.details: Phased production cutover for a pilot group, production dashboards for pipeline health and data freshness, alert routing, rollback procedure, and a two-week hypercare window.

tasks.name: Documentation & user enablement
tasks.details: Operator runbook (how to upload CSVs, interpret freshness badges, respond to data quality alerts), metric dictionary for analysts, and a short onboarding walkthrough for dashboard users.

tasks.name: SSO/OIDC login flow & session management
tasks.details: Wire the identity provider, handle callback and token refresh, enforce session expiry and idle timeout, and expose the current-user context to the app shell.

tasks.name: Role model & row/column-level access policies
tasks.details: Define viewer/analyst/admin capabilities, implement tenant scoping predicates injected into every query, and restrict sensitive customer columns (email, phone) to elevated roles.

tasks.name: API token issuance & service-to-service auth
tasks.details: Scoped, revocable tokens for scheduled report exports and internal service calls, with rotation guidance and audit logging of token use.

tasks.name: Upload endpoint & object storage handoff
tasks.details: Resumable multipart upload endpoint, file size and MIME validation, checksum verification, and durable handoff to object storage with an ingestion run record.

tasks.name: Chunked streaming parser & run bookkeeping
tasks.details: Stream-parse CSV in bounded chunks with a header-mapped reader, emit progress/row counts per run, and persist run status transitions so the UI can show ingestion progress.

tasks.name: Malformed-row quarantine & replay
tasks.details: Capture rows failing parse with their line numbers and raw text, expose them for download, and support replaying corrected rows without re-running the whole file.

tasks.name: Log collector & forwarder deployment
tasks.details: Deploy collectors to each log source, configure buffering and backpressure, and verify delivery health and lag metrics reach the observability stack.

tasks.name: Multi-format parser & field extraction
tasks.details: Format-specific parsers (JSON lines, syslog, plaintext regex) that normalize timestamps to UTC and extract severity, service, trace ID, duration and message into the canonical log record.

tasks.name: Dead-letter store & reprocessing path
tasks.details: Persist unparseable lines with source metadata, alert when the dead-letter rate breaches threshold, and provide a reprocess job after parser fixes are deployed.

tasks.name: Rollup aggregation jobs
tasks.details: Scheduled jobs computing per-service per-minute aggregates: request counts, error counts and rates, and p50/p95/p99 latency, written to partitioned rollup tables with hourly and daily roll-ups.

tasks.name: Query API with time-range, service & severity filters
tasks.details: Read API returning rollup series and paginated raw log search, with validated filter parameters, stable response schema, and clear error responses for unsupported combinations.

tasks.name: Query result caching & cost guardrails
tasks.details: Short-lived cache keyed on filter fingerprint, maximum time-range and scan limits per request, and rate limiting so a single dashboard user cannot exhaust the query engine.

tasks.name: Core chart primitives: time series, bar & stacked bar
tasks.details: Line/area time-series chart with brush zoom, plus bar and stacked bar with grouped series, tooltips and legend toggling, all driven by a single normalized data prop contract.

tasks.name: KPI tiles, heatmap & sparkline table
tasks.details: Stat tile with delta vs prior period, heatmap for hour-of-day by service error density, and a sortable table with inline sparklines and severity chips.

tasks.name: Theming, loading/empty/error states & accessibility pass
tasks.details: Shared theme tokens, skeleton loaders, empty and error illustrations for every component, colour-blind-safe palette, keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels on all chart elements.

tasks.name: Test plan & shared fixture datasets
tasks.details: Written test matrix mapping each pipeline stage and dashboard view to its test level, plus curated fixture CSVs and log samples (clean, dirty, edge-case) checked into the repo.

tasks.name: Unit & data-contract test suites
tasks.details: Tests for CSV parsers, validation rules, log format parsers and normalization, plus schema-contract assertions that fail the build when an upstream field type or nullability changes.

tasks.name: Integration & end-to-end smoke suites in CI
tasks.details: Pipeline integration tests on fixture data asserting expected row counts and metric values, plus a browser smoke test that loads each dashboard page and verifies charts render with data. Wired into the CI quality gate.

tasks.name: ADR: storage, processing & query engine selection
tasks.details: Compare storage engine, batch processing framework and query engine options on cost, operability and team familiarity; publish the trade-off table.

tasks.name: ADR: frontend, charting library & hosting sign-off
tasks.details: Choose the dashboard frontend framework and charting library, decide hosting model, and obtain stakeholder sign-off on the full ADR set.
